title: Expression-level concordance and implementation sensitivity of ligand–receptor priority rankings in mouse cerebral ischemia
description: Code, complete results, cell summaries, figure source data and observed environment locks for a cross-cohort reproducibility study in mouse cerebral ischemia. The analysis attributes the known shared-score ranking correction to scverse/liana PR #261, merge d4211373692e7b9c10210488ccb1efe06452b097. Full native LIANA 1.10.0 inference and fixed-commit aggregation-only replay are distinct execution scopes. A separate controlled-resource analysis executes native CellChat 2.2.0.9001 on all eleven original libraries, preserving full networks, native RDS scores, normalized sparse inputs, exact resource mappings and zero-effect diagnostics. The original v2 numerical analysis remains unchanged. Original project code is MIT licensed, derived tables/figures/manuscripts are CC BY 4.0, and third-party source/database files retain their own licenses. Large original GEO and corrected full-gene cell matrices are obtained separately; their aggregates and complete results are included.
